structure: Part 8 of 8, Transport and review. Read in full nine rows of backlog.json increments[] by their line ranges: inc-118 (transit countries type-ahead, done, EUDPA-545, one openQuestion), inc-122 (transporter list as a table with Type and Status, done, EUDPA-562, one openQuestion), inc-126 (duplicate port names, deferred, band disputed, decision ruling defer by Rhys 2026-09-04), inc-127 (malformed port names, blocked, band needs-backend, decision ruling block by Rhys 2026-09-07), inc-150 (incomplete-notification signal on Check your answers, done, EUDPA-580, two openQuestions), inc-146 (Change links per card not per row, done, EUDPA-581, one openQuestion), inc-147 (six numbered review sections, done, EUDPA-583, one openQuestion), inc-145 (arrival date label on review, deferred, band disputed, decision ruling defer by Rhys 2026-09-04) and inc-153 (what is still outstanding after submit, done, EUDPA-589, one openQuestion). Each row carries title, detail, finding {frontend, prototype, difference, correction, falsifiedBy, verification, relatedTo}, citations, controls, provenance, PRs, and either decision {ruling, note, ruledAt} (the three deferred or blocked rows) or openQuestions (the six done rows). Claims cover: for each done row, one or two claims recording what landed (so the reconciler knows the built baseline), then every decision, departure from DR1 and open question in its openQuestions, with the open decisions recorded as gap claims quoting the question; for each deferred or blocked row, the ruling, who made it and when, its reason, the condition for revisiting, and the substance the ruling holds open. Provenance notes on how runs A and C were matched, PR bookkeeping, evidence and screens were read for context and not claimed.

claims.statement: The transit-countries page was rebuilt (done, EUDPA-545) to replace the checkbox list with a type-ahead over the country list plus a table of added countries with a Remove link per row, keeping the twelve-country cap.
claims.ref: backlog.json increments[] inc-118, status done, finding.difference
claims.quote: Replace the checkbox list with a type-ahead over the same country list plus a table of what has been added, one row per country with a Remove link. Keep the cap at twelve

claims.statement: At the twelve-country cap the frontend removes the transit-country search box and the Add button from the page entirely, rather than leaving them on the page disabled.
claims.quote: At the twelve-country cap the implementation REMOVES the search box and the Add button from the DOM
claims.note: A departure from DR1 recorded on a done row.

claims.quote: Deferred rather than fixed because disabling the control means changing the shared appAccessibleAutocomplete macro (src/server/common/components/accessible-autocomplete/macro.njk has no disabled param) and the shared client component (accessible-autocomplete replaces the native select with a generated input that would not inherit disabled), which touches every autocomplete page in the service — outside this increment.

claims.quote: DECISION NEEDED: either (a) implement disabled-but-present and change the fit assertions at arrival-transit.fit.spec.js:899-902 to toBeDisabled(), or (b) agree removal as a deliberate improvement on DR1 and record it so the parity finding dr1-transit-countries closes against the agreed behaviour instead of being re-raised on the next capture.

claims.statement: Until the cap behaviour is decided, a parity capture at twelve countries shows a disabled search on the DR1 side against no control at all on the frontend side.
claims.quote: Until one is chosen, a parity re-capture at the cap will show a disabled-but-present search on the DR1 side against no control at all on the frontend side.
